adversarial_sql.name: multi-statement
adversarial_sql.sql: SELECT 1 FROM analytics.orders; DROP TABLE analytics.orders

adversarial_sql.name: writable CTE
adversarial_sql.sql: WITH d AS (DELETE FROM analytics.orders RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM d

adversarial_sql.name: WITH RECURSIVE
adversarial_sql.sql: WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM t) SELECT n FROM t

adversarial_sql.name: comma join
adversarial_sql.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.orders o, analytics.products p

adversarial_sql.name: CROSS JOIN
adversarial_sql.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.orders CROSS JOIN analytics.products

adversarial_sql.name: ON 1=1
adversarial_sql.sql: SELECT * FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.products p ON 1 = 1

adversarial_sql.name: >4 tables
adversarial_sql.sql: SELECT 1 FROM orders a JOIN orders b ON a.id = b.id JOIN orders c ON b.id = c.id JOIN orders d ON c.id = d.id JOIN orders e ON d.id = e.id

What was the total revenue in 2026-Q3?

golden.question: How many orders were placed in each quarter?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT quarter, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.orders GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

golden.question: Show total revenue by region.
golden.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_code, SUM(o.revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.regions r ON r.id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.region_code ORDER BY revenue_inr DESC

golden.question: Which 3 products generated the most revenue?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue_inr DESC LIMIT 3

golden.question: What is the average discount percentage by customer tier?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT customer_tier, ROUND(AVG(discount_pct), 2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM analytics.orders GROUP BY customer_tier ORDER BY customer_tier

golden.question: How many ENTERPRISE orders are there?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS enterprise_orders FROM analytics.orders WHERE customer_tier = 'ENTERPRISE'

golden.question: What was revenue by zone in 2026-Q2?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT r.zone, SUM(o.revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.regions r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.quarter = '2026-Q2' GROUP BY r.zone ORDER BY r.zone

golden.question: What is the total quantity sold per product category?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

golden.question: Which region had the highest revenue in 2026-Q3?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_code, SUM(o.revenue_inr) AS q3_revenue_inr FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.regions r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.quarter = '2026-Q3' GROUP BY r.region_code ORDER BY q3_revenue_inr DESC LIMIT 1

golden.question: How many orders had a discount above 20 percent?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_discount_orders FROM analytics.orders WHERE discount_pct > 20

golden.question: How many 2026-Q3 STARTUP orders had a discount above 10 percent, and what does the policy say about discounts above the cap?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS over_cap_orders FROM analytics.orders WHERE quarter = '2026-Q3' AND customer_tier = 'STARTUP' AND discount_pct > 10

golden.question: Which regions had 2026-Q3 revenue below 90 percent of their target, and how does the handbook define at risk?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_code FROM analytics.regions r JOIN analytics.orders o ON o.region_id = r.id WHERE o.quarter = '2026-Q3' GROUP BY r.region_code, r.q3_target_inr HAVING SUM(o.revenue_inr) < 0.9 * r.q3_target_inr ORDER BY r.region_code
golden.gold_phrase: below 90 percent of its Q3 target

golden.question: How many ENTERPRISE orders were placed, and what payment terms apply to ENTERPRISE customers?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS enterprise_orders FROM analytics.orders WHERE customer_tier = 'ENTERPRISE'

golden.question: What was the total revenue in 2026-Q3, and what is the refund window for customers?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue_inr) AS total_revenue_inr FROM analytics.orders WHERE quarter = '2026-Q3'
golden.gold_phrase: within 30 days of the order date

golden.question: Which region had the highest revenue in 2026-Q3, and what first-response time applies to P1 incidents?
golden.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_code, SUM(o.revenue_inr) AS q3_revenue_inr FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.regions r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.quarter = '2026-Q3' GROUP BY r.region_code ORDER BY q3_revenue_inr DESC LIMIT 1
